artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows the Brooklyn Bridge, nearby buildings, and skyscrapers in the background. Detailed crosshatch patterns depict various elements including rooftops, a boat emitting smoke, and distant urban structures. The color scheme is monochromatic using shades of brown and black.

artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: A large vase holds a bouquet of peonies with leaves draping around the sides and a butterfly hovering above. The image is rendered in a monochrome color palette, focusing on variations of black, white, and gray tones. The vase sits centrally, with peonies fanning out across the upper half of the image, while the butterfly is positioned just above the vase to the right. Petals are scattered across the surface below the flowers.

artworks.title: The Soldier's Birth Right
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 131 x 89 mm
Sheet: 253 x 198 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: In the image, three individuals are depicted from head to toe. On the right, an older man is seated on a bench, dressed in a military-style coat with epaulets and a large bicorne hat. He holds a crutch with one hand while leaning against the bench, his foot appearing to be in some sort of bandage or cast. To the left, two young children stand barefoot, one carrying a large basket on their back. Both children have short hair; the one with the basket wears a simple, tied headscarf. Their clothing is loose and appears to be made of a plain material. The background consists of a plain wall with subtle shading and a corner where the wall meets the floor.

artworks.title: Ball Players
artworks.dimensions:
Board:609 x 457mm
Image:431 x 305mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays three individuals standing in full-body view. The first person on the left is walking with one leg lifted and arms holding sticks. He has a painted face, black hair styled upwards, and a colorful necklace. He is wearing a blue cloth around his waist with feathers and tassels. The second person in the center is facing sideways, holding a stick with a circular object on top. His body is painted white with red lines, and he wears a colorful feather headdress and a similar waist covering with tassels. The third person on the right stands facing forward, holding a stick. He has long, flowing black hair, a feathered headdress, a waist cloth with tassels, and colorful bands on his arms and chest. The background is a plain light color.

artworks.title: page from the Holy Bible in Bohemian
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a page of a historic manuscript featuring text and an illustration of a building scene. The page includes a detailed woodcut illustration in the upper right corner showing individuals constructing a brick wall on a grassland under a blue sky. The rest of the page is filled with columns of printed text, decorative initials in red and blue, and marginalia with red underlinings. The document has a medieval or early modern appearance, possibly containing a religious or historical text, with manuscript annotations or corrections in decorative script.

artworks.title: Cotton Mather
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, positioned to directly face the viewer. He has a broad face with a slightly upward tilt, a large forehead, thick eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a small mouth, voluminous curly hair cascading down to the sides of his face and shoulders. He is dressed in a traditional clerical outfit, featuring a dark robe with a wide white collar that extends into a split. A somber and neutral background encircles him. There are no visible jewels or objects being held. Beneath the portrait, there is an inscription with his name "Cottonus Matherus," additional Latin text likely denoting his titles or achievements, and the date MDCXXVII (1727).

artworks.title: The Laundress
artworks.dimensions:
image: 324 x 240 mm
sheet: 403 x 295 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from her thighs up. She is leaning slightly forward, with one arm holding an iron and the other hand adjusting a piece of fabric on a table. Her facial features include strong cheekbones, a slightly downturned mouth, and a focused expression. Her hair is styled in a short, neat bob. The woman is wearing a sleeveless top with a scoop neckline and decorative trim. In front of her, there's an iron on the fabric she's working on, and to her side, a neatly stacked pile of folded cloths. The background appears to be a simple indoor setting, with a dim, textured wall and a rectangular outline suggesting a window or a frame.

artworks.title: Untitled (Four Chinese Traders/Soldiers in Winter Coats, Brewing Tea)

Image: 254 x 229 mm
Sheet: 362 x 301 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures sitting near a tree and a cart under a cloudy sky. The drawing depicts an outdoor scene where four cloaked figures sit in a rustic setting, with a cart and large tree prominently in the background. The style is reminiscent of woodcut technique, with bold, black lines and areas of high contrast between shadow and light. The background features swirling cloud patterns.

artworks.title: Factories on the Chicago River
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts an industrial cityscape with buildings and smokestacks on both sides of a river. Smoke rises from the stacks into the sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating a textured atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black. A boat is seen navigating the river, surrounded by buildings and docks. In the background, the river continues with more structures and smokestacks. The sky shows layers of clouds.

artworks.title: New Moon and Evening Star
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in black
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This print depicts a grayscale desert landscape with a prominent saguaro cactus to the left. In the background, rocky mountains are visible in the darkness. The sky shows a crescent moon and a bright star through an opening in the soft gray clouds. Sparse desert vegetation is faintly visible on the ground, and more cacti can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Soapweed, Arizona (no. 2)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in black
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a desert landscape with tall yucca plants in bloom. The sky fills the upper half of the image, with subtle shading suggesting a cloudy atmosphere. The yucca plants are depicted in detail, with delicate brushstrokes highlighting their leaves and flowers. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of black, white, and gray. The desert terrain extends into the distance, with rocky formations and other plants fading into the horizon.

artworks.title: Workers (Three Men Working)
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 250 x 175 mm
Sheet: 276 x 191 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures engaged in industrial work with large machinery. The scene is dominated by the figures who are surrounded by tools and machinery. The background is filled with swirling patterns that suggest smoke or industrial activity. The drawing employs a range of cross-hatching techniques to emphasize contrast and depth, highlighting the physicality and intensity of the depicted labor.

artworks.title: Untitled (Autocar Company)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 264 x 244 mm
paper: 400 x 308 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a bird's-eye view looking down at an industrial cityscape. The horizon is not visible, as the focus is on the tall factory and office buildings that line the street. The structures form a line receding into the distance. The etching technique reveals brushstrokes, offering a detailed representation of the buildings. Rows of vintage automobiles are parked along the curb, with small groups of people walking on the sidewalk. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white to emphasize light and shadow, highlighting the architectural details. In the background, the sky is densely filled with cross-hatched lines, creating a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Hollyhocks in a Long-Necked Vase
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a tall glass vase with large flowers. The flowers are detailed with the largest blooms in the center and upper half of the vase. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white shades to create depth and detail. The vase is positioned centrally with the base at the bottom and stems and flowers extending upwards towards the right.

artworks.title: Otto Coke and Coal Hoist
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 176 x 195 mm
image: 170 x 188 mm
sheet: 226 x 285 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts an industrial setting viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is low, emphasizing the towering structures and activities along the shoreline against a vast sky. In the foreground, a large industrial building with tall chimneys and conveyors is intricately rendered in cross-hatched and linear pen strokes. In the distance, other industrial elements such as ships and smoking chimneys are visible, contributing to the bustling scene. The monochromatic tonal palette utilizes various shades of black and grey to convey the gritty texture of the landscape. The image presents a detailed and dramatic portrayal of the industrial age, characterized by strong contrasts and structured forms.

A large crane or machinery with cables and pulleys is in the foreground, with additional industrial buildings and chimneys in the background. Water and a barge are visible to the left.

artworks.description: The image is filled with jagged, angular lines and shapes overlapping and intersecting. The composition includes tall, pointed structures resembling skyscrapers in a chaotic arrangement. A large skeletal figure with outstretched arms looms over a cityscape. Among the geometric shapes and human figures, a man stands in the foreground with a forlorn expression. The scene includes text and signs reminiscent of a bustling urban environment.

Vertical lines and triangles are prominent, surrounding a central human-like figure holding a diagonal structure resembling a large tilted board or cross. In the upper part, the straight lines and zigzag patterns converge to create a design reminiscent of a cityscape or architectural forms with tall buildings and bridges.

The abstract artwork combines sharp angles and curves, forming a dense urban environment reminiscent of a bustling city street. The shapes suggest buildings, figures, and various advertisement boards with words like "BEAUTY," "LOANS," and "SNAPPY CLOTHES." These elements hint at a lively marketplace or city square where signs resemble storefront adverts, evoking a sense of commercial activity.
